# Wipe

Reveals the next image behind a moving edge: a straight line at any angle, a circle growing from a center, or a clock hand sweeping around it. The edge can be soft and glow in the theme accent.

<EffectDemo effect="wipe" />

## Usage

```ts
import { createTransition, toHoloEffect } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { wipe } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/wipe';

const effect = wipe({ preset: 'iris' });

// Standalone: blend two textures as progress goes from 0 to 1.
const player = createTransition(renderer, effect, {
  from: textureA,
  to: textureB,
});
player.progress = 0.5;
player.render();

// With HoloCSS: hand it to transition3d().
import { transition3d } from '@mk7s/holocss/three';
await transition3d(fromElement, toElement, toHoloEffect(effect), {
  target,
  update,
});
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.pattern = 'linear'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                            | Default      | Range        | Description                                                                                                                               |
| ---------- | ------------------------------- | ------------ | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pattern`  | 'linear' \| 'radial' \| 'clock' | `'linear'`   |              | Shape of the moving edge.                                                                                                                 |
| `angle`    | number                          | `0`          | -180 – 180 ° | Linear: direction the edge travels. Clock: where the hand starts.                                                                         |
| `center`   | [x, y]                          | `[0.5, 0.5]` | 0 – 1        | Radial and clock: center of the wipe (UV).                                                                                                |
| `softness` | number                          | `0.05`       | 0.001 – 0.5  | Width of the edge, as a fraction of the wipe.                                                                                             |
| `reverse`  | boolean                         | `false`      |              | Run backwards: right to left, edges in, or anticlockwise.                                                                                 |
| `edgeGlow` | number                          | `0`          | 0 – 4        | Accent color added along the edge. Above about 0.6, a glow sweeping across the screen within a second can count as flashing (WCAG 2.3.1). |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                             |
| --------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `iris`    | `pattern: 'radial'`, `softness: 0.02`, `edgeGlow: 1` |
| `clock`   | `pattern: 'clock'`, `softness: 0.01`                 |
| `curtain` | `angle: -90`, `softness: 0.2`                        |
| `glowing` | `angle: 30`, `softness: 0.08`, `edgeGlow: 0.5`       |

Apply one with `wipe({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Transitions · tracked as story X13.3 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** transition. `createTransition(renderer, effect, { from, to })` runs it on two textures; `toHoloEffect(effect)` turns it into a HoloCSS `ThreeEffect` (parameters are baked in when called), with the `hcss-swing-left` CSS fallback. See [transitions](/guide/transitions).
- **Motion:** driven by `progress` from your timeline. HoloCSS skips transitions when motion is off; standalone, set `progress = 1` instead of animating.
- **Size:** 6.1 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/wipe`, including the shared effect runtime.
